articles.summary: First United Bank & Trust is pleased to announce that Jane Haines has joined the bank as Vice President, Mortgage Relationship Manager, bringing 35 years of banking experience, a proven record of success in mortgage lending, and longstanding ties to the North Central West Virginia community.
articles.title: First United Bank & Trust Welcomes Jane Haines as Vice President, Mortgage Relationship Manager

articles.summary: Customers are receiving fraudulent texts and phone calls about Zelle® transfers. The caller may know personal or account information and may even claim to be a First United Bank & Trust employee. Do not let that convince you the call is legitimate.
articles.title: Please Be Alert: Fraudsters Are Impersonating First United
